content: Sine Kristus tuku mbal rar tamŋgig
Kristus nu ŋgarosu ŋak minmba nu rar suŋgo tina. Tane mata wamdus ndui ta ŋak minap. Ande nu une maŋau te-ibeŋam tuku ŋgarosu rar tate ta nu une maŋau kusrekate.
Ta tuku tane kilke te mbolŋge minmba ŋgarosu tuku nzali ŋakmba tidoŋga Kuate tuku nzali kumnemŋge minap.

Tane buk kiko kugatok ŋgarosu tuku nzali ŋgail ndaka une maŋau kam tuku wamdus saŋgrinu pilnaig. Tane kule kamenu suŋgomba nyumba afu ndoŋ maŋgurka isukusmba maim-maimkinaig. Tane yabri mbara dubika mbar sugo fare fare ke likinaig. Kuate dubi ndade mbal maŋau nzaliniŋgit ta tane buk ke kumunaig.
Kile tane nane ndoŋ maim maim sugo kile-mayokka wam ŋaigonu ndui ta kam tuku ulendi ndakade le nane tane tuku piriri ŋayomba ŋgumnem pasa tiŋgig.
Kuate nu abo minig mbal kumanu mbal pileniŋgam tuku minit ta nane nu tugumŋge naŋgine mbar kile-mayokkuwaig le nu pileniŋgamŋgat.
Kumanu mbal mata pasa mayenu isnaig. Nane une tuku lafunu kuramba kume likinaig ta naŋgine kanu Kuate taŋaŋ minmba minam tuku nane pasa mayenu isnaig.
Sine afu turniŋbe
Agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kugawam tuku ait buk patukate. Ta tuku taŋgine ŋgarosu tuku nzali ŋakmba tidoŋga wamdus kuyar mayenu ŋak lika Kuate yabaŋmba minap.
Taŋgine taŋgine lato lato muŋgu kume purkap. Maŋau taŋge taŋgine mbar gudommba saukate.
Taŋgine taŋgine wande muŋgu ŋgailka ande gubra ŋak te ndakap.
Kuate nu ake sinaŋ saŋgri yimyam tiŋgina ta tane kulat mageka tambi taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu turkap.

Ande nu pasa kukliwam kande Kuate tugumŋge tumba kukliwa. Ande nu afu turniŋgam kande nu Kuateŋge saŋgri tuwit tambi nane turkuwa. Tane taŋamba kap ta wam ŋakmba mbolŋge Yesus Kristus tuku saŋgri mayok kuwa le Kuate tuku nyu afuŋge te-duŋgamŋgaig. Nu nuŋe nyu kilŋa saŋgri ŋak minmba minwa. Son.
Tira kame, piti sugo tane tagotiŋgam tuku pa taŋaŋ tane pasokade ta tuku tane piriri ŋayo ndawap. Kristus tuku mbal piti kurawam tuku mineg ta sine kila.
Tane Kristus ndoŋ ulendika nu piti kamusna taŋamba piti afu kamusde ta tane gare-garekap. Kristus nu nyu suŋgo pasa ŋak mayok kuwa le tane nu ndoŋ gare suŋgo tamŋgaig.
Tane Kristus tuku kuasmbi tukunu afu tane tumail pantiŋguwaig kande tane gare-garekap. Kuate tuku Guwa mayenu tane ndoŋ minit tukunu nane taŋade.
Tane ande bale ndawap. Agaŋ ande kuayar ndawap. Wam ŋaigonu ke ndakap. Taŋgo ande tuku wam mayenu kuer ndakap. Tane mbar taŋaŋ kumba rar kamusap ta kiko.
Tane Kristus tuku nyu ŋak minmba rar tumba kande tane nyu ta kikonu yube ndaŋgap. Tane Kristus tuku nyu ŋak minig tukunu Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgap.
Kile Kuate nu tugu pilmba sine nuŋe mbal pilesiŋgit ta nu tuku pasa mayenu pitaide mbal nu nane pileniŋmba ame piti niŋgamŋgat.
Kuyar pasa ande teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Taŋgo magenu nane muskil kile-tidiŋgam tuku maŋauŋge liniŋgam ndafloniŋgit.
Ata. Kuate idus ndamba wam ŋaigonu kade mbal ta siŋka ŋgisikamŋgaig ŋgate. Sindaun 11.31

content: Kuate nu nuŋe nzali dubiwa le afuŋge rar tiŋguwaig kande taŋgine ŋgarosu Kuate wai mbolŋge pilmba maŋau tiŋreknu ndo kumba minap. Kuate nu tane wakeikina ta nu tane kulatka kusreke nda.
